column3: NKJV has “all these things,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “these things.”
NKJV has “the things which the Gentiles sacrifice,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “what they sacrifice.”
NKJV includes “for me” in both clauses, following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV has “offered to idols” and adds “for the earth is the LORD'S, and all its fullness,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “offered in sacrifice” and lacks the quotation.
